title: I built an AI stock-research tool that shows counterevidence and missing data
author: Affectionate-Rule-52
selftext:
I built Fillion because I was tired of stitching together charts, fundamentals, recent news, options positioning, and separate AI chats for every ticker.



The output is designed as a research workspace rather than a signal seller: it presents a thesis, the evidence for and against it, important technical and options levels, explicit data gaps, and conditional setups with entry, cancellation, stop, target, and time-window logic when the inputs support them.



I’m looking for traders willing to test one ticker and challenge the output. The feedback I care about most is:



• Which claim or number looks stale, wrong, or unclear?

• Is the counterevidence strong enough?

• Is the invalidation logic useful before a trade?



Try it: [https://www.fillion.ai](https://www.fillion.ai)



Disclosure: I’m involved with Fillion. It is research-only, not an auto-trader, signal service, or promise of returns. Not financial advice.
